shared_engine: Legacy APIs use the same parser/evaluator internals with Meter's no-stop policy; controlled APIs use the caller's WorkControl through Meter.

polling.per_character_or_token_loops: Charge/poll at each consumed source unit or visited token. Meter chunks any grouped charges at no more than 256.

publication_and_errors.owned_source: Arc cloned only after controlled parse succeeds; stopped/error paths do not alter caller strong count
publication_and_errors.overlay: fallibly reserved and locally accumulated; returned only after complete evaluation success
publication_and_errors.stop_priority: meter stop propagated before original parse error mapping
publication_and_errors.cycles: accepted syncbase-cycle behavior remains inactive tracks

parity: All 12 archived original integration-test bodies match current bodies after whitespace normalization. Fixture controlled/no-stop parse tables, diagnostics, and overlays match across 15 fixtures at five times.
